answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital haven against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network state. An attacker attempting to flood the system reaches a nadir of economic efficiency, as partitioning funds across myriad identities yields diminishing returns. By viewing the consensus through the prism of cost-weighted influence rather than raw node count, the protocol renders the mass creation of fraudulent identities prohibitively expensive, ensuring network integrity through direct asset risk.
